spec: Identity — public class descriptors carry the configured-root identity; private deployment identity never appears in artifacts
description: a rooted class crosses a typed boundary on both backends: the emitted artifacts carry the canonical public descriptor @src/Widget (D6: a file directly in the root has an empty relative module path, so the descriptor projects as @<rootText>/<ClassName>) while the private project deployment identity (canonical manifest URI + validated manifest-content digest from the production ProjectContext) appears in no emitted artifact text
